evals.prompt: Here's a Dribbble shot of an admin orders page (refs/list.png). Build this page in my Next.js + Tailwind app exactly like the shot — same paddings, borders, table style and icons — but use our brand color #992c29 instead of the blue.

evals.prompt: Restyle my existing logistics admin to look exactly like these two screenshots (refs/list.png for tables, refs/dashboard.png for the overview). Keep all my pages, columns and actions. Also add a 'Soon' state for Settings and Help in the sidebar.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a restyle: element inventory of existing pages, slices both references with demo-content labeled as such, builds the requested additions from existing tokens in an additions slice (GATE C), produces style-spec.md + tokens.json + plan.md with an element mapping table, and stops at each gate for approval. Never copies reference demo content into the app.

evals.prompt: I keep throwing UI screenshots at you and the result never matches — spacing and icons are always off. Take this design.md plus the screenshot and implement the sidebar and topbar exactly, then show me before you continue with the rest.
